lpSeedingSelectors.note: Calls whose token transfers are liquidity provision, not sales (when sent to a liquidity manager or router). Each selector was found in the bytecode of the Monad liquidity manager it belongs to (v4 PositionManager, v3 NPM, v2 Router02) on 2026-10-29; no Monad LP-seeding tx was decoded. nad.fun tokens get LP from the curve at graduation (no wallet tx).
